maxPf.description:
MaxPF (Maximum Parallelization Factor):  The theoretical maximum number of actions
that can happen in parallel at any time of the run.

apf.description: PF (Actual Parallelization Factor): Maximum number of actions that executed in parallel during the run.

minPf.description:
MinPF (Minimum Parallelization Factor): An approximation of the smallest number of processors that suffice to execute a workflow
with the same latency as its PLB metric.

title: Metrics used to evaluate each run of a {@link Workflow}.
